Two Nigerian fashion designers, Abelia Franklyn and Segun Aladejana, have gained international attention after American rapper Cardi B wore their creations for her Billboard Canada cover editorial. The designers, whose labels are Weizdhurm Franklyn and Sevon Dejana, featured in the rapper’s fashion looks following her recognition as the inaugural Global Woman of the Year at the 2026 Billboard Canada Women in Music ceremony in Toronto on Tuesday. Cardi B shared photographs of the outfits on her Instagram page on Tuesday, with the caption, “Global Woman of the Year 2026. Thank you so much @billboardca.” One of the outfits was a sculptural blue mermaid gown designed by Franklyn and features exaggerated feather-like detailing at the neck and hem. The piece is from the brand’s Spring/Summer collection “The Remembering (Ncheta),” inspired by Igbo-Ukwu bronze art. Franklyn has built the label around sharp tailoring, clean construction and effortless sophistication. While the brand is known for contemporary menswear that balances classic elegance with modern refinement, this high-profile womenswear moment underscores its growing reach. Sharing the photographs on the brand’s Instagram page on Wednesday, the designer wrote, “Cardi B @iamcardib stuns in Weiz Dhurm Franklyn for Canada Billboard Women of the Year wearing a sculptural blue mermaid gown featuring an exaggerated feather-like detail on neck and hem from our Spring Summer 2027 Ready to Wear; The Remembering (Ncheta) – A collection inspired by Igbo-Ukwu Bronze Art.” The second outfit was created by Aladejana’s Sevon Dejana. Cardi B wore a structured jacket and matching skirt from the label’s Out of Body Haute Couture Spring/Summer 2027 collection. Announcing the look on Instagram on Tuesday, the designer wrote, “CARDI B, Discover Global Superstar @iamcardib in our OUT OF BODY Haute Couture SS27 gold, red and wine crystal embroidered structured jacket and skirt for @billboardca @billboard cover. “Styled by the amazing @kollincarter thank you so much.” Aladejana’s interest in fashion is rooted in his family background. His maternal grandparents ran a tailoring shop in Obalende, Lagos, where he was exposed to the craft. He has developed a reputation for refined occasion wear that blends impeccable tailoring with modern femininity The designer has since dressed several celebrities, including Nollywood actress Ini Edo and model Olandria. The two designers’ appearance in Cardi B’s Billboard Canada editorial highlights the growing international visibility of Nigerian fashion designers and their work. Meanwhile, Cardi B became Billboard Canada Women in Music’s first-ever Global Woman of the Year.
